title: Kiti cha Enzi Kilichosafiri kwa Mara Moja
intro: Mtu mwenye mamlaka makubwa alitawala ufalme tajiri uliobarikiwa utajiri usiopimika. Changamoto isiyotarajiwa ilipotokea, mtawala huyu alikabiliwa na jaribio si la panga bali la hekima na imani. Kile kilichotokea kingeongoza kutoka kilele cha mamlaka ya kidunia hadi mabadiliko makubwa ya moyo.
clues: Nilitawala ufalme uliobarikiwa utajiri na ustawi usio na kifani
Nilikuwa mfalme mwenye nguvu ambaye alipokea barua ya ujasiri ikidai uwasilishaji
Wakuu wangu walinishauri kuhusu kupigana au kufanya amani na mfalme huyu wa mbali
Niliondoka na zawadi nzuri sana ili kukutana na mfalme huyu wa mbali mwenyewe
Kiti changu cha enzi cha kifalme kililetwa katika nchi ya mbali kwa kufumba na kufumbua jicho, kabla sijaweza kurudi
Nilipoingia kwenye jumba lenye sakafu laini kama kioo, hatimaye nilitangaza kujisalimisha kwangu kwa Mwenyezi Mungu

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
